intro: Find public records. Check the source.

gapText: No complete, directly verified dataset is available in this snapshot. Consult the official source; missing records do not mean no records exist.
charterGap: The inspected Citizens’ Charter page showed table headings but no service rows. This does not mean the municipality offers no services. Eligibility, requirements, steps, fees and processing times have not been verified.
notFoundText: The requested URL does not identify a published record. The URL has been preserved; search the portal or choose a topic.
noResults: No matching captured records. Try another term; this is not proof that no public record exists.
contactWarning: Official-page contacts, not live-validated. Publication dates and current operation are not established. Do not rely on this snapshot as current emergency guidance.
rosterWarning: Current official roster unresolved. Compare the source-specific claims below; disputed counts and names have not been merged into a canonical list.
secondary: Secondary evidence; direct primary cross-check pending
correctionText: Submissions create public GitHub review issues, not immediate data changes. Provide evidence, not sensitive personal information. A GitHub account is required.
noGeometry: No licensed official municipality or barangay polygon has been verified. No official boundary is drawn.
noAdvisory: No verified current advisory feed is available. A source link is not a current warning. Consult the issuing agency for current safety information.
loadError: Public data could not be loaded. Reload the page or consult the official portal.
sourceDescription: Publisher records, retrieval limits and linked public evidence. A search result is a lead, not direct verification.
downloadDescription: Validated JSON, CSV and schemas generated from reviewed canonical files. Upstream rights remain source-specific; CC0 does not grant rights to upstream content.
accessibilityPolicy: The portal provides keyboard navigation, visible focus, labeled controls, semantic headings and language-preserving URLs. Record titles remain original when reviewed translations are unavailable. Report accessibility barriers through GitHub with the URL, browser and steps, without personal information.
privacyPolicy: The portal has no accounts, analytics, cookies or database. Language and filters are stored in URLs. The static host may retain access logs. External sources and GitHub apply their own privacy policies; issues are public. Do not submit private phone numbers, patient or household details. Reports never update published data automatically.
licensePolicy: CC0 applies to project code and project-authored schemas and normalization only. Upstream rights remain source-specific.
